STAGE 1

Write the whole-module specification

InputClean RTL module: autovcoder_102974.v
InstructionDescribe the whole module’s interface and observable behavior in self-contained prose.

Protocol summary; exact prompt wording is retained by the evaluation runner, not this historical import.

OutputGenerated whole-module specification (prose).
Read input: autovcoder_102974.v · Open raw
module autovcoder_102974 #(
    parameter CDBITS     = 18,  // clock divider bits
                                // Clock freq.  bits
                                //       12MHz  16
                                //       25MHz  17
                                //       50MHz  18
                                //      100MHz  19
                                //      200MHz  20  etc.
    parameter POL        = 0,   // polarization
                                //   0 - common anode (output active low)
                                //   1 - common cathode (output active high)
    parameter SELECT_POL = 0    // output select signal polarization
                                //   0 - active low
                                //   1 - active high
) (
    input  wire        clk,     // system clock
    input  wire [15:0] d,       // display digits, from left to right
    input  wire [ 3:0] dp_in,   // decimal point input vector
    input  wire        sign,    // sign
    output wire [ 0:6] seg,     // 7-segment output
    output wire [ 3:0] select,  // select output (controls common anode/cathode)
    output wire        dp       // decimal point output vector
);

  wire [3:0] on_mask;
  wire [3:0] sign_mask;

  seg7_4d_ctrl_raw #(
      .CDBITS(CDBITS),
      .POL(POL),
      .SELECT_POL(SELECT_POL)
  ) seg7_4d_ctrl_raw (
      .clk(clk),
      .d(d),
      .on_mask(on_mask),
      .dp_in(dp_in),
      .sign_mask(sign_mask),
      .seg(seg),
      .select(select),
      .dp(dp)
  );

  seg7_4d_pad seg7_4d_pad (
      .d        (d[15:4]),   // input digits
      .sign     (sign),      // input sign (0 +, 1 -)
      .on_mask  (on_mask),   // on-digits mask
      .sign_mask(sign_mask)
  );
endmodule

InputThe generated Stage 1 specification plus the required top-module name autovcoder_102974.

Stage 1 output → abstraction gate → fresh Stage 2 input. The intermediate text is generated separately for each model/attempt. It is not a prefilled golden description. Stage 2 receives neither the clean RTL nor the Stage 1 conversation.
